> **Time is the language we use to make sense of change, and the prison we build when we mistake the language for the thing itself.**

And when your deadlines start laughing at you? That’s the universe winking. It’s saying, “You’ve been speaking my language all along. Now it’s time to *listen*.”  

So go ahead—try to live like time is a mirror, not a master. I’ll be here, watching the clock tick backwards, sipping tea, and wondering if the tea is sipping me.  

😏<|im_end|>
